text: After a motorcycle crash in the Quebec countryside, Rose Miller undergoes [an experimental skin-graft operation|origin|monsters people made] at the Keloid Clinic and wakes from her coma able to survive only on human blood. A red stinger hidden beneath her armpit lets her [feed on strangers|threat|blood drinkers], and each victim [turns rabid and attacks others|rules|it passes to others]. As she hitchhikes into Montreal, a foaming epidemic spreads through subways and shopping malls until martial law and roadblocks close around [the abandoned city|who_suffers|whole communities].
